message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on Chinese law. Facts: selling protected plant varieties under false names, infringing plant variety rights, illegal business. Likely "侵犯植物新品种权罪" (Violation of plant variety rights) under the "Plant Variety Protection Law" and criminal law article 225? Actually Chinese Criminal Law article 225 deals with "侵犯知识产权罪" (infringement of intellectual property rights). Specifically, selling protected plant varieties without permission is infringement of plant variety rights, which can be prosecuted under article 225 (2) "侵犯专利权、商标权、著作权、植物新品种权等知识产权，情节严重的". So charge: "侵犯植物新品种权罪" or "侵犯知识产权罪". Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the main is infringement of plant variety rights. The question: "这部分事实构成什么罪名？一行作答。" Provide single or multiple. Likely "侵犯植物新品种权罪". Could also be "非法经营罪" for selling at lower price? But main is IP infringement.

Thus answer: [罪名]侵犯植物新品种权罪<eoa>
